subject: NimbleHealth estimate + deck — quick receipt check & optional walkthrough
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-02T14:22:00Z
Subject: NimbleHealth estimate + deck — quick receipt check & optional walkthrough

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time today — I appreciated the context on your API volume and latency SLOs. Per our conversation I attached two items: a short estimate that maps to the 2x-4x concurrency profile we discussed and the product serving deck that highlights batching/caching approaches that will move unit economics for NimbleHealth.

Attachments: [NimbleHealth_Redwood_Estimate_2028-12.pdf (1.2MB)], [Redwood_Serving_Deck_v5.pdf (3.8MB)]

If helpful I can walk through the estimate and call out where autoscaling and prefix caching produce the biggest cost delta — happy to do a 15-minute screen share. My availability is on my calendar here: https://cal.redwood.ai/logan/15min or I can propose a couple slots next week.

Next steps I recommend:
- Confirm receipt of the PDF (so procurement has what they need)
- Quick 15-min walkthrough if you want us to call out the cost levers
- If procurement prefers a different format (SOW, spreadsheet), let me know and I’ll convert

Cheers,

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

--

Sarah / procurement team —

Hope you’re well. Circling back on the estimate + deck I sent earlier this week. Quick note: if procurement needs a one-page cost summary or a CSV version of the numbers to drop into your internal finance model, we can produce that same day.

Possible 15-min slots (all PST):
- Tue 12/12 10:00–10:15
- Wed 12/13 11:30–11:45
- Thu 12/14 14:00–14:15 (holding per Sarah's note)

If priority has shifted, no problem — a quick reply with timing or 'not a fit' helps me prioritize our remaining capacity. If you prefer I can also send a more condensed one-slide summary that calls out the three biggest cost levers specific to NimbleHealth.

Thanks —

Logan Wright

One ask from procurement: can you include a brief note on data residency and audit logs (SOC2 + where logs live) — they want that in the packet. Karthik, Marissa — if you can add a line or two in the pre-read, that would help speed approval.

Thanks,
